name: Beast Tamer's Talisman
description: A flower carved from flint and Drakite, signifying that its bearer is qualified to become a beast tamer.

name: Mountain Ranger's Marker
description: A signal used by mountain rangers to mark out paths. Their bird-feather shapes make them very eye-catching indeed.

name: Mystic's Gold Dial
description: A golden disc shaped like a sun. The draconic patterns on it seem to symbolize the cycle of life and death.

name: Wandering Scholar's Claw Cup
description: A strange goblet strikingly similar in shape to a dragon's claw. Its maker must have made it with something special in mind.

name: Demon-Warrior's Feather Mask
description: A feather mask with falcon-esque plumage. Many legends surround this object.
